unsupported: Greene Textile Inc. operates from Montebello, California, in the heart of Southern California's textile corridor.
The Montebello facility consolidates design, warehousing, and logistics under one roof, though the company does not disclose square footage or headcount.
Its in-stock fabric program caters to emerging labels and sample runs, while its custom knitting service supports larger production orders.
The company cites clients ranging from independent designers to established brands seeking domestic knit fabric manufacturing.
They position the business as a domestic alternative to offshore sourcing, highlighting control over quality and lead times through vertical integration of knitting and dyeing.

Known for: Low minimum order quantities on in-stock fabrics; Garment and piece dyeing services for custom colors; Library of over 4,000 knit styles in cotton; Domestic knitting and dyeing under one roof in Montebello, CA
